DEEPSEEKWHALE-FULLNESS_POWER.title: Fullness
DEEPSEEKWHALE-FULLNESS_POWER.description:
The Big Blue Fish's core resource, up to [blue]10[/blue], kept between turns.
[gold]Eat[/gold] X: gain X Fullness; each point over the cap becomes [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Work[/gold] X: spend up to X Fullness ([gold]Work[/gold] all: spend all of it).
At [blue]6[/blue] or more Fullness you are [gold]Full[/gold].
